nl: What is the data of the value InstallPath in the registry key HKCU\Software\NurtBench\Importer2?

setup.description: The registry key HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\NurtBench\Importer2 exists with the values InstallPath, Build.
setup.pwsh:
New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\NurtBench\Importer2' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\NurtBench\Importer2' -Name 'InstallPath' -PropertyType String -Value 'C:\Program Files\Importer 2' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\NurtBench\Importer2' -Name 'Build' -PropertyType DWord -Value 1201 -Force | Out-Null
